method.reap_score: reap_sum / reap_count from the merged 12.8M-token capture
method.ablation: zero selected routes belonging to the layer prune set, then preserve original total router mass by renormalizing surviving routes
method.all_selected_fallback: retain the strongest original route if all top-8 routes are in the prune set

limitations: Route masking measures causal contribution under the original top-8 selection; it does not reroute to the ninth-best expert and does not reduce compute.
One record per domain is a sensitivity probe, not a quality benchmark.
The high-REAP arm is a positive control, not a proposed pruning policy.
No BF16 checkpoint exists; rankings and interventions apply to the deployed NVFP4 model only.
